name: hull_water
description: Leeway's water along the hull (engine/audio/voices.hpp, HullWater): slow lapping at rest, a rushing wash that grows and brightens with speed (0 .. 1, the boat's speed over its top speed). Leeway's numbers: a 0.13 Hz swell with a 3x harmonic on the lapping, lapping noise low-passed at 180 Hz, wash low-passed at 300 + 1700 * speed with gain 2.2 * pow(speed, 1.3), then Leeway's water 0.45 and master 0.8 into tanh. Deviations: the swell is evaluated once per 128-sample control block, not per sample; distance and stereo placement (Leeway's boatReference and rolloff) are the adapter's, not this recipe's.
